ch02.before: Wang Leping and Wang Yaqiao went back years in Shanghai
ch02.caption: Wang Leping (third row, second from left), Wang Yaqiao's good friend and a core figure of the Reorganizationists' military campaign against Chiang, in the group photograph of delegates to the Third Plenum of the Kuomintang's Second Central Executive Committee, March 10, 1927. Front row, from left: Ding Weifen, Gu Mengyu, Xu Qian, Tan Yankai, Sun Ke, Soong Ching-ling, T.V. Soong, Eugene Chen, Jing Hengyi, Wu Yuzhang. Middle row: second from left, Dong Biwu; third from right, Mao Zedong. Caption as given in the original edition.
ch02.alt: Group photograph of the March 1927 KMT Third Plenum delegates

ch04.before: "Brother Xiaolin — it was because I listened to you

ch04.caption: “The Hangzhou street tough Zhang Xiaolin became one of the Green Gang bosses of the Shanghai concessions. During the war of resistance he took part in collaboration with the Japanese, and was assassinated in August 1940.” Caption as given in the original edition.

ch05.caption: Chiang Kai-shek (first from left), Wang Chonghui (second from left), Hu Hanmin (third from left) and Wu Chaoshu at Tangshan outside Nanjing, April 1927. Four years later Hu Hanmin was placed under house arrest by Chiang Kai-shek at this same Tangshan, setting off a wave of opposition. Caption as given in the original edition.
